title: SubscribeEquityResult
description: Phase 2 (watchlist-trigger): result of SubscribeEquityActivity.subscribeEquity. status=FAILED is returned (not thrown) so the workflow can audit and proceed without a feed. status=GATED is returned when live use is not enabled (stock WS not configured) — the worker fails closed and does not connect.

subscription_id.description: Opaque ID for the active subscription. Empty string when status!=SUBSCRIBED.

subscribed_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the subscription was created (or attempted).

status.description: Outcome. FAILED (source error) and GATED (live use not enabled / fail-closed) return instead of throwing so the workflow can audit and continue.

error.description: Error message when status=FAILED or GATED.
